about_the_game:
This Real Time Strategy game puts you in the perspective of the Martians in their attack and conquest of Earth, their young sunward neighbour. They want you to lead their attack to successfully take over Earth to escape their dying planet, Mars. Will you lead them to victory, or will you fail the Elders?

You will need to research, construct and develop your assault on the enemy humans. You must defend and construct your base on Earth, research and development your weaponry on Mars, you must also test your weaponry to make sure that it is ready to launch to Earth and help on the attack. Conquer Earth each country at a time, for you to successfully take the country, you must destroy and eliminate the country’s heart. You will start your assault in the highlands of Scotland and work your way down towards London, once you have taken London, Great Britain is yours to control. Now you can conquer the rest of the globe. Always command your units strategically, it helps overcome the offence. However it’s not going to be easy, as the problem is of course the humans.
